# Incredible Heart

> Cardiology practice in Saint Louis, MO led by Dr. Kunal Gurav, MD, FACC, MBA, offering same-day in-person and virtual cardiac care, remote monitoring, and ongoing cardiac support.

Incredible Heart provides personalized cardiac care for patients seeking a dedicated cardiologist, whether in-person at our Saint Louis, Missouri office or virtually from home. We accept 100+ health plans and prioritize same-day appointments.

## Services offered

Holter Monitors, Cholesterol Test, Echocardiogram, EKG Monitoring, Exercise Stress Test, Heart Health Screening, Mobile Cardiac Telemetry, Nuclear Stress Test, Preop Clearance, Remote Patient Monitoring.

## Conditions treated (specialties)

Aortic Aneurysms, Aortic Valve Stenosis, Arrhythmia, Atrial Fibrillation, Blood Clotting, Bradycardia, Broken Heart Syndrome, Carotid Artery Stenosis, Chest Pain, Coronary Artery Disease, Deep Vein Thrombosis, Heart Attack, Heart Failure, Heart Murmur, Heart Palpitations, High Blood Pressure, High Cholesterol, Low Blood Pressure, Mitral Valve Prolapse, Mitral Regurgitation, Pericarditis, Peripheral Arterial Disease, Postural Orthostatic Tachycardia Syndrome (POTS), Shortness of Breath, Sleep Apnea, Stroke, Sudden Cardiac Death, Tachycardia, Transient Ischemic Attack, Varicose Vein, Vertigo.

## Incredible Membership

A proactive-care program that integrates user-friendly at-home monitoring devices (real-time heart-health updates, treatment-progress tracking) with in-person visits when needed. There is no extra fee beyond the patient's normal insurance copay.

## Virtual Cardiac Rehab

Three areas of ongoing support: at-home monitoring, personalized cardiac-care plans, and continuous/ongoing care — delivered via virtual or in-person consultations.

## Weight Management Program

Page: https://incredibleheart.care/weight-management

A physician-supervised weight management program run by the same cardiologist, combining personalized diet and lifestyle guidance, insurance-approved weight management medication, a home-delivered smart scale, and coordinated management of related cardiac conditions. Can be combined with the Heart Disease Management Program (personalized treatment plans, evidence-based therapies, team-based care, and home cardiac monitoring devices) under one care team.

## Immigration Medical Exam (Form I-693)

Page: https://incredibleheart.care/immigration-exam

Immigration Medical Examinations (Form I-693) performed by a USCIS-designated Civil Surgeon. $439, covering two office visits; payment is due at the first visit. Process: (1) initial exam, which identifies any additional testing needed; (2) insurance-covered additional testing at a facility of the patient's choice, with referrals provided; (3) a second visit to complete and seal Form I-693; (4) the patient receives the sealed documents to submit with their immigration application. Bring an unsigned, most-recent-edition Form I-693 with Part 1 completed (but not signed), medical and vaccination records, and a photo ID. Language translation is available during the visit.

## FAQ

Q: Is there a fee for my Incredible Membership?
A: No — Incredible cardiology services are offered at no extra cost other than the patient's insurance copay, which is determined by their insurance plan.

Q: Is the weight management program covered by insurance?
A: Most patients pay only their normal insurance copay; coverage for specific medications varies by plan and is verified before treatment starts.

Q: Do I need a separate cardiologist and weight-loss provider?
A: No — Dr. Gurav manages both under one program.

Q: How many visits does the immigration medical exam take?
A: Two — an initial exam, then a second visit to complete and seal Form I-693 once any additional test results are back.
